correctness.rationale: Kummer’s carry theorem identifies the support with binary integers avoiding adjacent 1 digits. For any four equally spaced values with positive d, divide out the largest power of two dividing d; the four quotient residues modulo four include 3, forcing forbidden adjacent bits. Eight reachable states in a two-addition carry automaton count all three-term progressions including constant ones. The exact row identity u(M^6−2M^5−3M^4+4M^3+5M^2−2M−2I)=0 and verified six initial terms derive the rational series at every r. Subtract the Fibonacci constant-triple series to obtain z^2/((1−z−z^2)(1−z−3z^2+2z^4)). Actual standalone verify.py reconstructs the matrix and exact identity and compares direct enumeration; no infinite theorem rests on finite checks.

value.rationale: The support is simultaneously a classical automatic/digital set and a classical proportional-binomial parity locus. Three is its global maximum nonconstant arithmetic-progression length, and the all-spacing exact rational generating series counts every maximal-length progression at every dyadic cutoff, a natural complete additive invariant. Its degree-six carry mechanism and counts are not implied by Fibonacci cardinalities, fixed-row binomial positions, or generic rationality; it is not a routine one-line specialization.
